# Endless Testing

> A/B testing for AI generalists. Run A/B tests on a landing page from Claude, Codex, or ChatGPT through the CLI, MCP, or API.

Endless Testing runs rounds on a landing page. When a round ends, the winner stays live. The next round starts itself. The dashboard shows the current round and its results. The kill switch stops the round.

CLI, MCP, and API are equal. Claude, Codex, and ChatGPT can use any of them.

Use the `et` commands in this file. Older pages on docs.endlesstesting.ai still describe the previous npm CLI (`endlesstesting auth`, `endlesstesting run`). Those commands are not this CLI.

## Pricing

- 5 concurrent tests.

## How a round works

1. `et login` signs you in. `et site add` adds the landing page.
2. `et round start` opens the round.
3. When the round ends, the winner stays live.
4. The next round starts itself. `et status` reports the round.

## CLI

The binary is named `et`. Output is compact JSON. `ET_API` overrides the API base. The default base is https://api.endlesstesting.ai. `ET_TOKEN` overrides the token file. The token file is `~/.config/endlesstesting/token`.

`et login --email you@example.com` sends the same email code as the dashboard. `et login --code <code>` exchanges that code for an account token and writes the token file.

Add `--text` to print indented JSON. On `et goal set`, `--text` is the button label, not the pretty-print flag.

```
et login --email <email>
et login --code <code>
et logout
et whoami
et sites
et site add <url>
et snippet <site>
et check <site>
et goals <site>
et goal set <site> --text <button>
et brand <site>
et brand set <site> --field <k=v>
et brand autofill <site>
et round start <site> [--url <page>]
et status <site>
et results <site>
et feed <site>
et pause <test>
et resume <test>
et reject <variant>
et kill <site> on|off
et mcp
et help
```

`et help` prints this list. `et kill <site> on` turns the kill switch on. `et kill <site> off` turns it off.

## MCP setup

`et mcp` speaks MCP over stdio. The tools call the same commands as the CLI.

Claude Code:

```
claude mcp add endlesstesting -- et mcp
```

Codex, in `~/.codex/config.toml`:

```
[mcp_servers.endlesstesting]
command = "et"
args = ["mcp"]
```

ChatGPT and any other MCP client use the same stdio server: command `et`, args `mcp`.

Do not invent an API key. Sign in with `et login` or the `login` tool. Do not report a winner until `et results` shows one.

## MCP tools

- login: send a sign-in code or exchange it for an account token. Optional email, optional code.
- logout: revoke the account token and forget it.
- whoami: show the signed-in account.
- sites: list sites on the account.
- site_add: add a site. Requires url.
- snippet: print the install snippet. Requires site.
- check: report whether the snippet has been seen. Requires site.
- goals: show the conversion goal. Requires site.
- goal_set: set the goal button text. Requires site and text.
- brand: show brand context. Requires site.
- brand_set: set one brand field as k=v. Requires site and field.
- brand_autofill: fill brand context from the site. Requires site.
- round_start: start a round on a site. Requires site. Optional url.
- status: show live tests, challengers, and the round. Requires site.
- results: show finished rounds with winners and lift. Requires site.
- feed: show what the engine did. Requires site.
- pause: pause a test. Requires test.
- resume: resume a test. Requires test.
- reject: reject a variant. Requires variant.
- kill: turn the kill switch on or off. Requires site and state (`on` or `off`).

## SDK

Public pages install both tags below. The SDK blocks rendering when `blockUntilVariants` is omitted, so set it to false. The script tag needs `async` and `data-cfasync="false"` so Cloudflare Rocket Loader does not rewrite it. `et snippet <site>` prints a snippet with that site's domainId. Add `blockUntilVariants: false` before publishing that snippet.

```
<script>
window.AB_CONFIG = {
  base: "https://api.endlesstesting.ai",
  blockUntilVariants: false
};
</script>
<script src="https://api.endlesstesting.ai/api/sdk.js" async data-cfasync="false"></script>
```
